newsitem.title: USA: Utah Hunter coal-fired unit 2 seen back up Thurs.
newsitem.headline: Utah Hunter coal-fired unit 2 seen back up Thurs.

text.p: The 415 megawatt (MW) unit 2 at the Hunter coal-fired power plant in Castle Dale, Utah, is expected to be back on line by Thursday, sources familiar with the plant's operations said Tuesday.
The unit has been down since Saturday night for unplanned maintenance.
The Hunter plant, which is operated by PacifiCorp, also has a 420 MW unit 1 and a 440 MW unit 3.
PacifiCorp's ownership interest in unit 2 represents 270 MW of its capacity.
